scope: Research only: no language packs, production/configuration, deployment, or next batch was changed or started.

decision.why_null: Missing compatible/current source constraints prevent a valid estimate of that event; null does not mean nobody understands the game.
decision.summary_zh: 可落实按互斥母语 cohort、同一人口时点和已发布语言计算的去重框架；但现有证据仍不足以证明全球 80% 人口能看懂文字游戏。原 50 语言 81.0195% 是明确依赖历史母语比例及脚本可理解性的规划情景，不能用作停止条件。
decision.most_material_finding_zh: 原场景只容许印度所计母语 cohort 中约 6.83% 失去资格；年龄、识字或脚本标准任何一个未处理的问题都可能超过这个余量。

explicit_assumption_planning_estimate.formula: For each territory use CLDR maximum exact supported language/script marginal. In IN take max(that marginal, sum of selected disjoint exact C16 leaves / India 2011 total). In ID take max(that marginal, 0.98115 * age5plus_2025 / all_age_2025) if id is supported. Sum on the original CLDR population weights.
assumptions: C16 exact mother-tongue leaves remain the same shares of the current resident population after rescaling, despite 2011 observation year.
Every counted native-language person is counted as potentially language-reachable; literacy, age and chosen written-standard comprehension are not established.
Indonesia 2025 language ability and its age denominator are transferable to the CLDR population weight; rounding floor handles displayed decimal precision only.
CLDR's approximate mixed-vintage language marginals are usable point inputs; geographic duplication is not yet fully reconciled.
explicit_assumption_planning_estimate.overlap_conservatism: Only about overlap, conditional on the inputs and event definitions. It is not a statistical confidence bound, temporal bound or proof of reading.

risk_quantification.interpretation: Sensitivity calculations keep all non-India inputs fixed for comparability. Historical 2011 diagnostics are not present-day estimates; they demonstrate why the original event definitions are incompatible.

india_age.formula: max(0, selected_native_share - under7_share); do not multiply shares without a justified age-language independence assumption
india_age.meaning: If evidence qualifies only ages7plus and provides no language-by-age cross-tab, the lower endpoint of this scenario is below80. This does not assert every child under7 cannot read or assign the 2011 age distribution to 2026.

india_literacy.critical_limit: Any-language literacy is only a necessary proxy: it does not establish literacy in the person's mother tongue, the delivered script, or game vocabulary. The interval is for native association intersected with generic literacy, not a valid lower bound on actual written-game comprehension.
india_literacy.current_official_rate_scope: PLFS2023-24 gives80.9% ages7plus and79.7% ages5plus, not all ages and not language-specific.
india_literacy.threshold_interpretation: Holding the other50-code assumptions, 80.9% literacy of ages7plus could sustain the target only if uncredited under7 people were at most about1.65% of the Indian population. No current age distribution is inferred from this threshold.

india_written_standard.rule: An uppercase HINDI total cannot replace these exact leaves, and common Devanagari default does not establish mutual intelligibility of their written standards. Gurmukhi Punjabi cannot count pa-Arab in Pakistan; Hindi cannot automatically count Arabic-script Urdu.

indonesia.important: Age treatment already excludes all under5; it is conservative with respect to those excluded children. It does not turn speaking ability into reading or remove survey/vintage uncertainty.

geographic_duplicates.interpretation: These particular code overlaps are numerically smaller than the India reading/age issue. This exercise does not establish that all258 CLDR territories are disjoint or population-vintage compatible.
geographic_duplicates.cross_border_person_rule: Use one current-resident geography. A 2011-origin cohort projected as surviving persons cannot also be counted in a newer destination-country resident survey. Historical-share rescaling can be interpreted as current-resident estimates only under explicit, unverified compositional assumptions.

risk_quantification.global_age_scope: UN adult literacy88% applies only to ages15plus. It cannot be used as the all-population denominator or as a universal language-reading rate.

model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.principle: Use disjoint cohorts when the source establishes exclusivity; retain maxima only for populations with unknown overlap.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.target_event: A resident person can understand the written game in at least one released language/script; language availability or spoken reach may be reported separately under that label.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.population_partition: One official world population revision/date, nonoverlapping resident country/area units and age strata. Keep the world denominator unchanged when evidence for a country is missing; that country contributes no unsupported numerator.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.cohort_formula: For disjoint mother-tongue cohorts g in stratum t, proven supported-UI mass >= sum_g(N_tg * q_tg_lower), where q is a compatible language/script comprehension qualification bound. Unknown qualification receives no proof credit; q=1 is a planning assumption, not a census finding.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.combine_alternatives: Take max(cohort_union_lower, supported_single_language_lower, audited_joint_L1L2L3_union_lower) within the same stratum only when all measure the same event and population. Never add alternative estimates of the same residents.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.unknown_overlap: A sharp bound may be obtained by a small linear program: minimize supported-event union under documented marginal/joint constraints, nonnegative atom masses and the stratum population total. Subdivide only when evidence defines genuinely disjoint populations.
model_to_remove_the_maximum_estimator_ce.year_rule: A new total population does not bound a historical language share. Use compatible contemporary evidence or published/defensible cohort-change bounds; keep unbounded old-share extrapolations in a separately labelled scenario.
practical_next_evidence_priorities: Obtain and reconcile original C16 leaves/codes first; keep the current PDF-mirror transcription unverified until then.
Prioritize Indian language-by-age and language/script-reading evidence. It dominates the 81% sensitivity, so fixing only the XLSX download will not fix the estimate's event definition.
Audit C17 joint subsidiary-language structure before counting L2; merge coarse mother-tongue groups with C16 fine leaves by conservative constraints, not sums.
Preserve the internally checked Indonesian speaking/age figures as useful reach evidence, then obtain reading-specific data and published survey uncertainty.

Add audited disjoint language evidence from current official censuses such as Pakistan2023 and South Africa2022, with their exact script/age/geography scope. These can reduce dependence on stale Indian assumptions, but no gains are booked before extraction.

benefit_ranked_research_inventory.basis: Fixed50-code conditional language-reach model above; after assuming Spanish has eventually passed its current gate, start from zh/en/es and repeatedly select the remaining candidate with the largest incremental global estimate. Gains depend on preceding selections; do not sum standalone speaker totals.
benefit_ranked_research_inventory.baseline_actual_release_status: Only zh-CN/en are treated as released; Spanish remains a candidate pending its existing UI/revalidation gate.
benefit_ranked_research_inventory.not_effort_adjusted: No translation cost, native-review availability, script/RTL engineering, font coverage or deployment effort has been estimated. This is incremental population benefit, not implementation ROI.

all_gates_required: The event and all-age global denominator match the user's intended claim; an adults/readers/gamers denominator is not substituted silently.
Every counted locale has completed translation, native UI validation, independent revalidation, release and required deployment/health gates; only those released locales enter S.
Original source rows, source years, residence/age/sex selections, language standards and scripts are traceable and verified; group totals and constituent leaves are not both counted.
Country/area weights form a reviewed nonoverlapping world partition on one population revision/date; cross-border origin/destination stocks are not duplicated.
Only compatible comprehension/reading constraints are combined. Spoken language and mother-tongue association do not automatically qualify all persons for a written UI.

Known measurement and temporal uncertainties are documented and handled with defensible bounds or explicit sensitivity sets; published survey intervals are used where available. An overlap lower bound conditional on point estimates is labelled as such, not a statistical confidence bound.

The estimate remains >=80 across the reviewed uncertainty/sensitivity set. A material unresolved assumption that can consume the margin prevents the stop; no arbitrary safety discount or rounding creates a pass.
The evidence ledger and estimator receive independent review, and the released-locale set used for the computation matches the actual service build.
honest80_percent_stop_rule.optional_separate_reporting: Potential spoken/native language reach may be shown as a conditional planning estimate. It cannot set the written-game target flag without resolving the different event definition.
honest80_percent_stop_rule.why_not_now: Original C16 cells remain unverified, multiple source years/geographies are unharmonized, no Indian chosen-script reading qualification is established, and the official age/literacy diagnostics exceed the original margin. The50 locales are prospective, not all released.
